728-7084-8337.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

574-2317-4826-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-2317-4826-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
1251-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3967-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3967-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2415-6752-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6752-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4927-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3963-4872-7757-7758.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-4872-7757-7758.description:
Declare Meneldor as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Meneldor.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Time Warp.
Time Warp's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

104-360-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-360-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4905-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

3259-4302-4509-6633.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
3259-4302-4509-6633.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

1976-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
1976-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

4687-6287-7488.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Topiary Lecturer.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3992-7371.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Rite of the Dragoncaller
1618-2440-3992-7371.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rite of the Dragoncaller triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3992-7371.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Rite of the Dragoncaller. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3817-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3129-5421.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve the Redcap Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7154.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Condor enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1456-3459-4289-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3175-3605-4812-5147.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1402-2644-4763-6965.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6642-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6642-6965.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6642-6965.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

1669-3234-3293-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-6797.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-6797.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2511-3234-3293-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2511-3234-3293-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat
2511-3234-3293-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1940-3180-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Chamber Sentry from your library.
Repeat.

654-678-997-6644.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1947-3327-4613-4802.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4613-4802.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

3875-5226-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5226-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, and then an additional Clue or Treasure token for each remaining trigger.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

913-2440-2905-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Pestermite
913-2440-2905-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite with haste.
When the token Pestermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Pestermite, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Pestermite for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

64-372-1987.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-1987.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

864-2292-2639-3254-4871.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-2292-2639-3254-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-2292-2639-3254-4871.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nethroi.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate the seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3490-4659-5402.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4659-5402.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Pirate you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Pirate you control.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servos.

500-1308-2047-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-1308-2047-4365.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

3424-4944.description:
Activate Kazuul's Toll Collector by paying {0}, targeting any Equipment you control.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Kazuul's Toll Collector ability, attaching the Equipment to it.
Repeat.

2034-4749-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Somberwald Beastmaster, adding {C}{C}.
Somberwald Beastmaster dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Somberwald Beastmaster from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf, a 3/3 Beast and a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1349-2034-4153.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
1349-2034-4153.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

813-1283-4615-4739.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures.
813-1283-4615-4739.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {2}, adding {1} for each creature you control.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {3}, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
The Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, returning Battle Hymn and Quasiduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may return any other instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard in place of Battle Hymn.

2440-2634-4309.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Orc and/or Shaman.
2440-2634-4309.description:
Cast Electrodominance by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Electrodominance.
Resolve the copy of Electrodominance, dealing 3 damage to any target and casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
Rootha enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control two other Orcs and/or Shamans, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

643-1424-1791-2335.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
643-1424-1791-2335.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Kyler, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
